product_metadata.title: 2 Pack Salt and Pepper Grinder Set - Refillable Stainless Steel Pepper Mill Grinders, Upgrade Glass Pepper Grinder Set by Lascritta (5.2"x2.6")
features: [SALT AND PEPPER ARE NOT INCLUDE] - 2 Pieces salt and pepper grinders are equipped with brushed 304 stainless steel top, a clear thick glass body and non-corrosive ceramic blades. Come with a cleaning brush is the perfect addition to any kitchen and is also a great gift.

[EASY TO REFILL] - 5.2*2.6 inches ceramic grinder fits your hands perfectly and it has a 3/4 cup capacity to hold your spices without the need to constantly refill. The stainless steel top easily screws off for fast refills and has wide opening ensuring a mess free refill.

[EASY TO USE] - These salt and pepper shakers allow you to adjust coarseness from thin to thick by rotating the mill head. The salt grinder has an adjustable ceramic rotor, it can work very efficiently which have five gears for adjustment.

[MANUAL BENIFITS] - Use your salt and pepper grinder with a simple twist of the hand without having to worry about running out of power. It is manually operated and reusable. Maintain the freshness, keep moisture and dust away.
[VARIETY USAGES] - Salt grinder is the ideal partner for your kitchen, restaurant, outdoor picnic and party. it can be used to grind salt, black and white peppercorn, dried sesame etc.
